single_method_lane: Signature-only local fault-signature learner: multi-scale isotropic + strike-steered Gaussian derivatives of six 100 m stack bands (no raw contextual/habitat bands) plus 1 m/10 m DEM-derived within-cell scarp aggregates; HistGradientBoosting; spaced off-catalogue binary dot emission.
non_fault_mimic: Lake Lahontan shoreline benches/beach ridges and road/levee cuts (identical lidar scarp maxima, no fault).

E1.instrument: vendor/gems57, evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2, buffered_component_draw seed=20, hide_frac=0.20, buffer_px=3, visible-only strike field and flank

arms.CTRL_A2: raw19 + iso + steered (103 features), reproduced in-run; success criterion for instrument identity: B3@44090 pooled HOLDOUT-DTI within 0.005 of the published 0.1826
arms.SIG100: derivative columns only (84), ablation isolating removal of raw habitat bands
arms.SIGX: 84 derivative + 18 external local scarp/topo aggregates (102), the candidate

E1.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.06, max_leaf_nodes=63, min_samples_leaf=200, l2_regularization=1.0, max_bins=255, early_stopping=False, random_state=0); shared training sample (all visible positives, 450000 negatives, seed=20, flank_px=2)
E1.canary: symmetric single-feature AUC of every SIGX feature, withheld positives vs active background; any value > 0.90 stops the lane
E1.emission: gems78.emit.greedy_dots min_dist=2.8 px, pool=400000 (identical to published CTRL runs); flank B in {3,5} px from VISIBLE catalogue; budgets {37654, 44090}
comparators: registry D2.8 dots as-is (biased: built with full catalogue; labelled, never fold-fair)
registry H33 dots as-is (same bias, expected near-zero)
uniform-random surface, seed 123, same emitter B3

endpoints.overall: pooled HOLDOUT-DTI per config, paired 20 km spatial-block bootstrap, 1000 draws, seed 520810
endpoints.far_strata: same, with fold truth restricted to withheld pixels >10 px and >20 px from the visible catalogue (definition identical to scripts/diagnose_distance.py); evaluated for @44090 configs of every arm + D2.8 + random
endpoints.selection_rule_for_production_emission: among SIGX B x budget configs, maximize far>10 px pooled DTI (for @37654 use its @44090 flank-mate far ranking if strata not computed), tie-break overall DTI; the rule is fixed here, before results

gates.G3a_competence: selected SIGX config overall pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > random control and > D2.8-as-is on identical folds
gates.G3b_far_field: far>10 and far>20 paired deltas vs matched CTRL_A2 reported with CI; 'beats current holdout best overall' reported as a separate binary line vs CTRL_A2 best config
gates.G4_uniqueness: pre-placement |Spearman| < 0.90 and final forward 3 px dot overlap < 0.70 vs every restored sparse registry/production raster; continuous fields compared at matched-budget top-K and also literally (correction IR-78-22-03, flagged for owner ratification)
gates.G1_G5_production: only if G2+G3a pass: refit on full catalogue, full-catalogue strike field, production flank = selected B, budget = selected budget, binary zeros-outside TIFF via vendor submission_writer, independent scripts/verify_tif.py re-read

score_labelling: All new numbers are HOLDOUT-DTI unless copied from an organizer submission-page receipt (none exists). Owner-reported live scores are never relabelled.
slots: No weekly submission slot is used or approved by this registration (protocol rule 6).
